candidate_reports.remark: A tree was reported to have been blown down onto Ewing Road in the Fairview community. The event time is radar estimated.
A tree was reported to have been blown down at 1700 Grassy Lick Road blocking the entire roadway. The event time is radar estimated.
Trees were reported to have been blown down in Owingsville. The event time is radar estimated.
Trees were reported to have been blown down down on Sour Springs Road. The event time is radar estimated.
Trees were reported to have been blown down along US 60 near the Rowan and Bath county line. The event time is radar estimated.
Trees were reported down on Fraley Road and other locations in the Salt Lick vicinity. The event time is radar estimated.
Multiple trees were blown down onto and in areas near KY 519 between Morehead and Clearfield. Portions of KY 519 were closed due to debris. The event time is radar estimated.
Trees were reported down on KY 519 near or just north of the Morgan County line. The event time is radar estimated.
